description: Partial request-pattern mitigation. Rejects a nonempty externally supplied --configPath query directive.
affected_versions: craftcms cms: >= 4.0.0-RC1, < 4.13.2, >= 5.0.0-RC1, < 5.5.2, >= 3.0.0, < 3.9.14; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Rejects a nonempty externally supplied --configPath query directive.
limitations: Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Applications intentionally accepting this reserved configuration directive from clients are denied.
